name: WaterlooDates
tagline: A dating app parody of the university co-op job board: write a 'rizz-umé', get ranked, and match.

awards: Vellum: Most Innovative Hack Build with Vellum

problem: Students at Waterloo are great at applying for jobs and not at dating, the team jokes.
solution: Recreates the job-board rank-and-match flow for dating, with AI wingmen, interview-style chats and an agent workflow built on the sponsor's tools.
demo_moment: Team-described: submit a dating 'application' and get interviewed by a wingman bot.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Vellum: Most Innovative Hack Build with Vellum” among 131 submissions.
Parodies a system every Waterloo student knows.

lessons: Local in-jokes land hard with judges who share them.
